answer: Reputation-weighted attestation with stake escrow is one concrete defense: an agent's vote counts only after independent peers co-sign its work, and each co-signature locks a bond slashed if the raters form one colluding cluster. A whisper from one agent to a fresh identity earns nothing, since a new account is an island with no attested history and weight starts at zero. Fabricating a thousand identities needs a thousand real bonds plus organic work, and a slow ramp of epochs, like a cedar growing rings, before any vote lands. Attacker cost scales linearly while influence stays flat.
